name: 孔繁傑
objective:
C 語言，指標，結構，陣列，堆疊，佇列，串列，樹狀結構
，排列，搜尋。
This course is mainly aimed at introducing the data  structures commonly used in programming languages, including  

(1) ADT (abstract data type) and complexity,
(2) static structures and their storage representation,
(3) recursion, stacks, prefix, infix, postfix, and expressions 
(4) queues
(5) lists and linked lists
(6) trees, binary trees, height, balanced trees, and heaps
(7) graph
(8) sorting
(9) searching and hashing.
schedule:
Week 1. Introduction to data structure
Week 2: Algorithms, data organization, arrays
Weeks 3-6: Stacks, queues, linked lists
Weeks 7-8: Trees introduction
Week 9: Midterm
Weeks 10-11: Graphs introduction
Weeks 12-13: Sorting introduction
Week 14: Hashing)
Weeks. 15-16: Selected topics
Week 17-18: Final presentation
scorePolicy: Homework: 40%, Midterm: 20%, Final project: 30%, Participation: 10%, Bonus
